title: New seamless PIPESHARE animation on login and splash
description:
The PIPESHARE brand animation on the sign-in screen and the post-login splash has been replaced with a new seamless-loop version, so it no longer visibly jumps when it repeats.

Both screens now also show a still first frame of the animation while the video loads, instead of a brief black box. The new clip is much smaller than the old one, so the sign-in page loads a little faster.

If the browser blocks video or the user prefers reduced motion, the CSS PIPE/SHARE wordmark still shows so nothing breaks.

Who is affected: everyone signing into PipeShare on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Sign-in screen and post-login splash use the new seamless PIPESHARE loop (no visible jump on repeat).
Both screens show a still poster frame while the animation loads, removing the black flash.
Removed the previous animation file; CSS PIPE/SHARE wordmark remains the fallback.
